# Plan Example: Browser Widget, Links Open as a Glance

A plan as sent before building (2026-11-17), for delulu-smash's Browser widget. Worth noting as an example
of **UI requirements**: one text sketch of the screen shows the layout, the bar's buttons and where the new
tab lands. The other user of the component (the VODs player) is sketched right under it, so you can judge
"one component, two uses" by eye. The edge the user can't avoid (sites that refuse to be framed) is stated
with what they'll see, plus the cost of the alternative (an outside request per link). Answers given after
it: one reused tab, the always-on hint, and a follow-up from the user ("the spirit is Zen browser's glance")
that changed a click from "open a tab" to "float over the app first".

---

## What you'd see

Click any link in the app: a link in an AI chat answer, a VODs card's link, a start.gg link in a table. A
**Browser** tab opens in Results:

```
┌ Results ─ r1 │ r2 │ 🌐 smashwiki.info ×  ───────────────────────── ⤢ × ┐
│ [ https://www.ssbwiki.com/Little_Mac      ] Go   Open ↗   ×             │  ← the browser bar
│ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│ │                    (the page, in a frame)                            │ │
│ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **Address bar:** you can type another URL and press Go. "Open ↗" opens the page in a real browser window.
  "+" can add an empty Browser too.
- **Links with a rule:** a few kinds of link get rewritten to a version that can be framed, eg a YouTube
  `watch?v=…` link becomes YouTube's embed player. Links with no rule load as-is.
- **The VODs player** becomes this same component, with its own extra "Show list" button. The title, the
  "Open ↗" (today "YouTube ↗") and × become shared:
  ```
  │ Pro Smash: Sparg0 vs Tweek     Show list ▾   Open ↗   ×  │   ← browser bar + one extra button
  ```
- **The edge case:** many sites refuse to be shown inside another page (Google, X, often start.gg). Their
  frame stays blank, and the browser can't tell us it was refused. So the bar always says **"Blank? This
  site doesn't allow being shown here; use Open ↗."** Getting the refusal for sure would mean asking each
  site first (an extra outside request per link).

## Interfaces

```python
# ui/render.py — one component, two users
def web_frame(title: rx.Var[str], src: rx.Var[str], url: rx.Var[str],
              extra: tuple[rx.Component, ...] = (), on_close: Any = None) -> rx.Component:
    """bar (title or address box, *extra, Open ↗, ×) over an <iframe src=src>"""

def browser_widget(view, send, actions) -> rx.Component:   # the new widget
    return web_frame(address_box(view.url), view.src, view.url, on_close=send("close"))

def video_widget(view, send, actions) -> rx.Component:     # VODs, now built on it
    player = web_frame(playing["title"], embed, playing["url"], extra=(show_list_button,), on_close=send("stop"))

# ui/web.py — the link rules (data)
EMBED_RULES: list[tuple[re.Pattern, str]] = [
    (re.compile(r"youtube\.com/watch\?v=([\w-]+)|youtu\.be/([\w-]+)"), "https://www.youtube.com/embed/{id}"),
]
def frame_src(url: str) -> str:        # a rule's rewrite, else the url as is

# ui/widgets.py
Widget("browser", "Browser", new=lambda session: WebPage(url=""), addable=True)   # no tool: no inline AI

# links: render.link() and chat markdown links get data-browse; a click (assets/panes.js)
# calls State.browse(url) instead of a new tab; Ctrl+click still opens a real tab
State.browse(url) -> the "web" tab shows WebPage(url, src=frame_src(url))
```

## Decisions (asked with the question tool)

1. Clicking links one after another: **one reused `web` tab** (recommended) or a new tab per link.
2. Sites that refuse framing: **an always-on hint** (recommended, no requests) or check each site first
   (one HEAD request per link).
3. Follow-up, after the user named Zen's glance: **float first, dock on ⤢** (recommended). A click floats
   the page over the app, Esc closes it and puts the layout back, ⤢ keeps it as the `web` tab. The other
   option was straight into Results with no floating step.
